Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering in Healthcare & Life Sciences is delivered by an Achala practice team that stays through industrialization: Achala runs hospital-scale platforms under HIPAA-grade discipline — emergency response at 50,000+ daily cases, laboratory queues down 20-30%, telemedicine and patient portals in production. The baseline is signed before delivery starts, and the gates evidence every move.

The Cloud, Edge & Platform control frame for Healthcare & Life Sciences: HIPAA / HITECH (PHI safeguards, BAAs, breach notification and audit trails); GDPR / EU health-data regimes (special-category data, DPIAs and cross-border transfer controls); FDA SaMD / CDS guidance (clinical decision support under enforcement discretion boundaries and validation duties). Controls are designed against these duties up front, identity, access, retention and explainability are architectural decisions here, not audit-season retrofits.
